Put everything in a mixer, add garlic, pepper, and season. Once the hummus is ready, decorate with green olives and Persian pickles. Garnish with cumin, sautéed parsley, olive oil + garlic.
Note at bottom: carrot / leek / onion / cumin soup.

notes: Baking: Oven 400 degrees / 20 min baking time. Mushroom + shrimp (appetizer) listed below

title: Nachos (Beef)
instructions:
Cook time: 30 min, bake at 400F for 5 min (serve with pita chips). Sauté onions in oil, add pepper, olives, jalapeño. Add tomato paste + chili paste. Add ground beef, then beans. Add garlic and spices, then water and cook.
Ground beef, olive oil, 1 clove minced garlic, 1 cup red beans, 1 cup tomato paste, 1 tbsp chili paste, 1/2 chopped yellow onion, 1/2 bell pepper, 5 olives, water, spices (paprika, cumin, salt, pepper). Optional: 1 jalapeño, mozzarella cheese.

instructions: Remove the center stem of kale leaves, add salt and olive oil, and massage the salad. Add cranberries and walnut halves.

title: Zucchini Pancake (Kabak Mücveri)
instructions: Ground zucchini, after ground them squeeze it for getting rid of water. Then add chopped dill, parsley, onion and all other ingredients. Pan fried.

title: Amaretti
instructions: (Bake at 325°F for 25 min): Whisk 2 egg whites with salt until stiff. Whisk egg and sugars, then add to egg whites. Fold in almond flour, almond and vanilla extracts. Roll into balls, coat in powdered sugar, and bake.

title: Baked New York Vanilla Cheesecake
instructions:
Crust: In a bowl, stir together crumbs, sugar and butter. Press onto bottom of lightly greased pan. Bake 325°F for 8 to 10 min. Let cool.
Filling: In a large bowl, beat cream cheese, sugar on low speed. Add eggs in, then blend in lemon juice, vanilla, salt, and then sour cream.
notes: Baking: Pour over crust. Bake at 325°F for 1h 15 min. Let cool, then refrigerate

title: Bavarois
instructions:
Whisk eggs and sugar, add milk, cook over low heat for 12-15 mins. Add gelatin and white chocolate, let cool for 20 mins, then fold in whipped cream.
Raspberry Mousse:
Cook 467g raspberries with 117g sugar for 5 mins. Pass through a sieve to remove seeds. Dissolve 4.5 soaked gelatin sheets in the hot raspberry syrup. Let cool, then fold into 47 cl whipped heavy cream.
Decor: Liquid raspberry jam, fresh raspberries, mint leaves.

title: Biscuit Vanille (Moelleux à l'intérieur)
instructions: Whisk butter, sugar, vanilla sugar, salt, and eggs with an electric mixer. Add flour and baking powder, mix until a malleable dough ball forms. Roll into small balls, place on parchment paper, flatten slightly. Bake at 350F (180C) for 20 mins (convection) or 25 mins (until golden on top/bottom). Option: put chocolate in the middle.

title: Cookie
instructions: Mix everything, roll out, refrigerate for ~30 min. Cut cookies, sandwich jam between two, dust with powdered sugar. Bake at 330F for 12-15 min. Let cool ~15 min (they will be soft out of the oven and will harden as they cool).

instructions: Fondre chocolat avec beurre, ajouter sucre, oeufs, farine et noix.

title: Gâteau aux pommes cardamome
instructions: Mix eggs, sugar, oil. Add flour + yeast alternating with apple juice. Pour into a greased pan. Cover with apples (like a tart). Bake at 350F, then 400F.

title: Gâteau fondant chocolat amande (sans lait)
instructions: Melt chocolate in a double boiler, when melted/soft add olive oil. Whisk eggs and sugar with a mixer until double in volume. Add almond powder to the egg-sugar mixture, then add the melted chocolate-oil mixture. Pour into a greased and floured pan (cook in its pan with greased parchment paper). Bake at 180C (350F).

title: Irmik Helvasi

ingredients.raw: walnuts (1 large cup, chopped in pieces)

instructions: Fondre beurre et cuire ~20 mins au 4-5. In a cold bowl, mix milk and sugar. When the irmik mixture is light brown, add walnuts, then add the cold milk + sugar mixture. Continue to cook. Boil the mixture, then reduce temperature to 1-2.

title: Marbré

ingredients.raw: half flavored with vanilla, half with melted chocolate
ingredients.note: divided batter; half with melted chocolate

instructions:
Alternate vanilla and chocolate layers, pass a knife through.
Glaze (optional): 150g liquid cream, 100g hot chocolate melted and added on top.

title: Mosaic cookie
instructions:
Cream butter in bowl, add sugar and whisk till fluffy.
Add yolk and essence.
Add flour.
Keep in fridge for 15 min.
Roll dough -> brush one side with water.
Cut dough into strips [alternating white and chocolate colors].
Keep in fridge for 15 min, then ready for baking @ 350F.

title: Oven-Baked Rice Pudding (Firinda Sütlaç)
instructions:
Clean and wash the rice. Cook it with 1 cup of water first. When it starts to absorb the water, add sugar and milk, followed by vanilla and butter. Whisk the starch and egg yolks with 2-3 tablespoons of water, temper it with a few spoonfuls of the hot pudding from the pot, then pour it back into the mixture. Stir well and remove from heat.
Pour into oven-safe ramekins/bowls. Arrange the ramekins in a baking tray filled with water. Bake in the oven until browned on top. Once out of the oven, you can cover them with another tray to prevent them from drying out.
If you want to make it without baking, there is no need to use eggs.

title: Rice Pudding (Sütlaç)
instructions: Boil the rice in water until soft. Add sugar and milk. Add the raw butter and boil for 2-3 minutes more. Pour hot into bowls and sprinkle with cinnamon.
notes: It is also possible to use 1 tea glass of rice and 1 tablespoon of flour. For weight-conscious individuals, preferring rice over flour and omitting butter is recommended. Not: 1 çay bardağı pirinç, 1 yemek kaşığı un da kullanmak mümkündür. Kilo sorunu olanların un yerine pirinç tercih etmeleri ve yağ kullanmamaları tavsiye edilir

title: Simple - Vanilla Cupcakes
instructions:
Preheat oven to 375°F (or 170°C); line muffin cups with paper liners.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy, then add eggs.
Add flour (mixed with baking powder and salt) alternating with milk, beat well; stir in vanilla.
Divide evenly among cups and bake for 18 mins. Let cool in pans.

title: Tiramisou

ingredients.raw: des cuillères de café fort, chocolat amer

instructions: Mélanger le sucre avec les jaunes - le mascarpone et ensuite les blancs en neige. Tremper les cuillères dans du café fort et les déposer dans un plat creux pas trop profond. Mettre la crème sur les cuillères - Refroidir pdt 4-5 heures - A la sortie du frigo recouvrir de chocolat amer.

title: Budget Waffle Batter (Pâte à Gaufres Économique)
instructions: Follow the same instructions as the classic waffle batter, substituting half the milk with water.

title: Béchamel Pasta Gratin (Gratin de Pâtes à la Béchamel)
instructions: Prepare the simple pasta gratin but pour a freshly made béchamel (made from 20g butter, 20g flour, and 250ml milk cooked together for 5 minutes) over the pasta before baking.

title: Choux Pastry (Pâte à Choux)
instructions:
Combine water, butter, and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat and pour in all of the flour at once. Stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until a smooth dough ball forms and pulls away from the sides. Dry the dough on low heat for 1 minute, stirring.
Once the dough has cooled slightly (no longer steaming), beat in the eggs one by one, mixing vigorously with the spatula until a smooth, shiny, holding-its-shape dough is obtained. Use immediately.
Pipe or spoon small mounds onto a baking sheet. Bake until puffed, golden, and dry. Let cool on a wire rack.

title: Classic Waffle Batter (Pâte à Gaufres Classique)
instructions:
Preheat your waffle iron and grease lightly.
In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, sugars, and salt. Make a well, add eggs and the alcohol, and mix. Whisk in the melted butter, then gradually add the milk until the batter is smooth.
Pour a ladle of batter onto the iron, close, and bake for 5 minutes. Serve hot with powdered sugar or whipped cream.

title: Crepe Batter (Pâte à Crêpes)
instructions:
Place flour in a mixing bowl and make a well in the center. Pour in the eggs, oil, and salt. Mix together.
Gradually whisk in the milk and water, beating well to ensure no lumps form. Once smooth, let the batter rest for 1-2 hours.
Heat a lightly greased skillet. Pour in a small ladle of batter, swirling to coat the bottom of the pan. Cook until golden, then flip. Serve warm with sugar or jam.

title: Crust (Pâte)
instructions: Mix butter, sugars, and salt. Add flour, almond powder, and eggs. Form dough into a ball, refrigerate for 1 hour. Roll out the dough, place in tart pan, and pre-bake at 400°F for 15 mins.

title: Dough (Gözleme / Börek)
instructions:
Thin layer of dough (spray oil + butter) filled with potato filling.
Cook onions, then add smashed boiled potatoes.

title: Egg and Tomato Pasta Gratin (Gratin de Pâtes aux Oeufs Durs)
instructions: Slice 4 hard-boiled eggs in half and place them in the gratin. Pour over 1 small can of tomato sauce seasoned with fresh tarragon before baking.

title: Fresh Tricolor Pasta with Chicory and Tomato Fondue (Pâtes Fraîches aux Fondues D'endives et de Tomates)
instructions:
Endive Fondue: Remove outer damaged leaves and slice endives in half. In a sauté pan, heat half the olive oil, add endives, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and a splash of water. Cover and cook gently for 15 minutes.
Tomato Fondue: Blanch tomatoes in boiling water for 1 minute, peel, and dice. In another pan, heat the remaining olive oil, sauté the chopped shallot without browning, then add tomatoes, salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar. Simmer uncovered, stirring often, until a thick sauce forms.
Boil the pasta according to package instructions; drain. Mix the pasta with the melted endives, scatter basil on top, and spoon the rich tomato fondue over it.

title: Fritter Batter (PÂTE À FRIRE - For Apple Fritters) (PÂTE À FRIRE (BEIGNETS AUX POMMES))

ingredients.raw: flavoring (2 tbsp rum or apple brandy/Calvados
ingredients.item: flavoring (2 tbsp rum or apple brandy/Calvados

instructions:
Mix flour, eggs, oil, and salt in a bowl. Slowly whisk in the beer or water until smooth. Let rest (it should be thicker than crepe batter).
Peel and core apples. Slice into 1/2 cm thick rings. Macerate the rings for 1 hour in rum/Calvados and sugar.
Dip the apple rings into the batter and fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Pasta with Mussels and Basil (Pâtes aux Moules et au Basilic)
instructions:
Scrub, de-beard, and wash the mussels. Sauté the sliced shallots in butter in a large pot. Add the white wine and the mussels. Cover tightly.
Steam over high heat for 5 minutes, shaking the pot several times, until all mussels open.
Remove mussels from their shells. Filter and reserve the cooking broth. Boil the pasta in salted water; drain.
Toss the hot pasta with the crème fraîche, the reserved mussel cooking liquid, and the shelled mussels. Garnish with basil strips and serve immediately.

title: Puff Pastry (Pâte Feuilletée)
instructions:
Mix the flour, oil, water, and salt to form a smooth, soft dough (the "détrempe"). Rest for 30 minutes.
Roll the dough into a rectangle. Place the softened butter in the center and fold the flaps of the dough over to completely seal the fat inside.
Roll the enclosed dough into a long, neat rectangle. Fold it into thirds like a letter. Rotate the dough 90 degrees so the fold is on your right. Roll out and fold into thirds again. This constitutes 2 "turns". Let the dough rest in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Repeat this rolling and folding process until you have completed 6 turns in total, resting the dough in the fridge after every 2 turns. Ensure the pastry is very cold before rolling out to bake.

title: Pâte aux Crevettes, Ail, Persil
instructions: Cook pasta in parallel. Heat oil, and sauté shrimp for 1.5 minutes on each side until pink. Remove shrimp. In the remaining cooking liquid, add salt, pepper, garlic, and butter. Sauté for 2 minutes (optional: add cherry tomatoes). When cooked, add parsley. Off heat, mix pasta, sauce, and shrimp together.

title: Pâte aux épinards

title: Pâte à Pizza
instructions: Let rest/rise in the machine for 1 hour. Form into 8 to 9 dough balls. Let rest for 30 mins before rolling out. Base toppings: dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella.

title: Seafood Pasta Gratin (Gratin de Pâtes aux Fruits de Mer)
instructions: Toss 1 liter of cooked, shelled mussels or cockles and a few fresh rosemary leaves into the simple pasta gratin before baking.

title: Shortcrust Pastry (Pâte Brisée)
instructions:
Place flour in a bowl. Cut cold butter into small pieces and add to flour. Rub the butter into the flour with your fingertips (or a pastry cutter) until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs or sand.
Make a well in the center. Pour in the water and salt. Mix quickly with a fork just until a cohesive dough ball forms (do not overwork, otherwise gluten will develop, making the pastry tough and shrink in the oven). Shape into a disc, wrap, and chill for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Rolling out: Lightly flour your work surface and rolling pin. Roll out from the center outwards to 3-4 mm thickness. Line a lightly floured tart pan, prick the bottom with a fork, and bake "à blanc" (par-baked/blind-baked) if needed, or fill and bake as instructed.

title: Shortcrust with Egg Yolk (Pâte Brisée Avec du Jaune D'oeuf)

Shortcrust with Oil (Pâte Brisée Avec de L'huile)

Simple Pasta Gratin (Pâtes au Gratin)
instructions:

Grease a gratin dish. Alternate layers of pasta, grated cheese, and butter flakes, ending with a layer of pasta. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese, breadcrumbs, and dot with butter. Drizzle with Madeira wine.
Bake in a hot oven until browned.

title: Chickpeas with Meat (Etli̇ Nohut)

ingredients.raw: 500g bone-in or 400g boneless cubed meat (beef or lamb)

instructions:
Soak the chickpeas in water overnight. The next day, drain the soaking water. Pour fresh water over them and bring to a boil for a few minutes (this reduces the gas-producing properties of chickpeas). Drain the water.
Finely chop the onions. Sauté them with the meat in oil. Add the tomato and pepper pastes, and sauté a bit more. Pour in 5-6 cups of hot water. Once boiling, add the chickpeas. Add salt near the end of the cooking process. Remove from heat before the cooking water is completely gone.
notes: If using ground beef instead of cubed meat, 250g is sufficient. (Pairs excellently with plain rice pilaf and salad.) Not: Et yerine kıyma kullanılacaksa 250 gram kıyma kâfidir. (Sade pilav ve salata ile iyi gider.)

title: Classic Quiche Lorraine (Quiche Lorraine)
instructions:
Roll out the puff pastry into a tart pan and prick the bottom with a fork.
Scatter bacon lardons across the bottom, then pour the whisked eggs, cream, salt, and pepper on top.
Bake in a hot preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Confit de Canard

ingredients.raw: Duck legs (cuisses) or duck breast (magrets), duck fat, garlic, thym, bay leaves (laurier), salt, pepper
ingredients.item: duck legs or duck breast , duck fat, garlic, thym, bay leaves , salt, pepper

instructions: Dry, salt, and pepper the meat. Place legs facing each other in a deep oven-safe dish (cocotte). Cover legs with duck fat, and add garlic, thyme, and bay leaves. Bake covered in the oven at 320°F (160°C) for 2 hours. At mid-cooking time, delicately flip the duck legs and return to the oven. Let cool in the dish with the fat. To serve, remove the duck from the fat and bake in a dish at 400°F until the skin is crispy.
notes: Tip: Use a bit of the duck fat in a pan to sauté onions, add peas and a little water

title: Dried Okra with Meat (Etli̇ Kuru Bamya)
Fried Eggs (Yağda Yumurta)
instructions:
Place butter in a pan or skillet and melt.
Carefully crack eggs one by one into the pan. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Fry until the egg whites are cooked and opaque.
If you prefer the tops of the eggs to be more well-done, cover the pan for 1-2 minutes after cracking the eggs.

title: Ham and Mushroom Pasta Gratin (Gratin de Pâtes au Jambon et aux Champignons)
instructions: Add 20g of diced ham and 200g of fresh mushrooms (sautéed in 20g of butter with a minced garlic clove) into the Béchamel Pasta Gratin before baking.

instructions: The ingredients and directions are identical to the recipe for white beans with meat (etli kuru fasulye).

title: Lahmacun

title: Lentil Ball (Mercimek köftesi)
instructions:
boil lentil (30 min).
add bulgur wait 30 min.
in a pan add olive oil, bell pepper, mint and spices, cook 2-3 min then add to the lentil-bulgur mix, add parsley and green onion, mix everything then shape it like a ball.

title: Macaroni and Ham Gratin (Gratin de Macaroni au Jambon)

ingredients.raw: 1 small can of mushrooms, rinsed and drained
1 small packet of grated Emmental cheese
ingredients.item: small packet of grated Emmental cheese

instructions:
Cook macaroni in boiling salted water; drain.
Prepare a light béchamel: melt 30g of butter in a saucepan, toss in the mushrooms and diced ham, then sprinkle with flour. Pour in the cold milk while stirring continuously. Once the sauce thickens, reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently. Add olives, saffron, tomato paste, and the cooked pasta. Simmer for a few minutes while stirring.
Once the sauce completely coats the pasta, remove from heat and transfer to a greased baking dish. Sprinkle with grated Emmental, breadcrumbs, and dot with the remaining butter. Bake at 210°C (th. 7) until golden.

title: Menemen (Melemen)
instructions:
Remove the stems and seeds of the green peppers. Wash, drain, and chop finely.
Put oil in a pan or wide skillet. Add the peppers. When they start to soften and slightly color, add the peeled and finely chopped tomatoes. Cover and stir occasionally. Once the tomatoes are cooked, make as many hollows (wells) as there are eggs. Crack the eggs into these wells. Cover with a lid. Remove from heat before the eggs become too hard. If you want the yolks to be softer, cook without covering with the lid. Sprinkle with black pepper and serve.
notes: Alternatively, you can scramble the eggs slightly and pour them over the tomato mixture. Not: Yumurtaların biraz karıştırılarak, domateslerin üzerine gezdirilmesi de mümkündür

title: Mushroom + Chicken
instructions: Cook onion with vegetable oil about 5 min. After add cutted chicken breast and cook 10 mins. Add mushrooms, cook 15 more mins. After mushroom and chicken blended together add all other ingredients and cook everything 20 more mins with medium heat.

title: Palace-Style Eggs (Sarayda Yumurta)
instructions: Slice the onions into half-moons. Sauté in olive oil until they soften and become translucent (mother-of-pearl color), without browning too much. Crack the eggs on top. Add salt and mix slightly. Transfer to a serving dish.

title: Practical Manti (Prati̇k Manti)

ingredients.raw: 250g pasta (usually small shells or elbow macaroni)
ingredients.note: usually small shells or elbow macaroni

instructions:
Bring a generous amount of water to a boil in a pot. Add salt. Add the raw pasta, raw ground beef, and very finely chopped onion and black pepper together. Boil uncovered until cooked. Remove from heat. Cover the pot and let it rest and steam for 5-10 minutes.
Plate the pasta mixture. Top with garlic yogurt and melt butter in a pan with red pepper flakes and drizzle over the dish.

title: Pide
instructions: Shaping: open little round dough then fold slightly all around then pull from both sides, then put the top filling. Same with lahmacun except paste and pure mixed eggs.

title: Poisson à la bordelaise
instructions: Sauté shallot and garlic with olive oil. Add white wine, lemon juice, and parsley. Off heat, add breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper. Spread mixture over the fish, bake in oven drizzled with olive oil for 15-20 min at 200C.

title: Saffron Milk Cap & Brousse Cheese Ravioli (Ravioles à la Brousse aux Lactaires Délicieux et Poivre de Séchouan)

ingredients.raw: chives, flat parsley, cilantro, chervil, chopped
ingredients.note: fresh herbs; flat parsley, cilantro, chervil, chopped

instructions:
Blanch the mushrooms in boiling salted water for a minute, rinse in cold water, and press dry under a weight. Chop them coarsely with a knife.
In a saucepan, melt the butter and sweat the shallots. Add the chopped mushrooms and cook, stirring constantly, for a few minutes. Season with salt and the finely crushed Sichuan pepper.
In a bowl, mash the Brousse cheese with a splash of balsamic vinegar, then stir in the cooked mushroom mixture and the chopped fresh herbs. Season to taste.
Roll out the ravioli dough as thin as possible. Cut and fill the ravioli, sealing the edges with water or egg wash. Cook in boiling salted water for about 6 minutes. Serve with a creamy carrot or zucchini coulis. Recommended pairing: Châteauneuf-du-Pape wine.

title: Salmon Trout and Chanterelle Quiche (Quiche de Truite Saumonée aux Chanterelles En Tube)
instructions:
Clean the leek and cut into 3 cm thick diagonal slices. Wash thoroughly and boil in salted water; drain and set aside.
Blanch the chanterelle mushrooms in salted boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Rinse in cold water and squeeze dry. Sauté the mushrooms in butter in a pan over high heat until lightly browned and their moisture evaporates. Drain and let cool.
Poach the trout fillet in water flavored with thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper until just cooked. Flake the fish meat.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry to a thickness of 5 mm and line a tart pan (individual tart pans can be used for this quantity).
Par-bake the crust in a hot oven for 5 minutes, then add the mushrooms, leek, and trout. Whisk the cream, eggs, grated Comté cheese, salt, and pepper, and pour over the filling.
Bake at 180°C/th. 6-7 for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve hot, preferably demolded immediately to prevent the crust from softening from steam condensation. Best accompanied by a seasoned green salad.

title: Seafood Quiche (Quiche aux Fruits de Mer)

instructions:
If using cockles, soak them in salted water to purge any sand.
Prepare the shortcrust pastry and line a tart pan. Prick the bottom with a fork. Clean and scrub the mussels.
Open the mussels in a pan over high heat with the white wine, peeled and chopped onion, and parsley sprigs. In a separate pan, quickly open the cockles. Remove both from their shells. Distribute them over the pastry base along with the peeled shrimp and chopped scallops.
Filter the cooking liquid from the shellfish through a paper coffee filter, and keep 1/2 cup. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with heavy cream, the filtered cooking liquid, and pepper. Pour over the seafood. Bake in a preheated hot oven (200°C/th. 7) for about 30 minutes.

title: Traditional Turkish Manti (Manti)
instructions:
Sift the flour onto a pastry board. Add the egg, salt, and enough water to knead a very firm dough. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 30 minutes.
Finely chop the onion. Mix with the ground beef, finely chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the rested dough on a floured board to a thickness of 3 mm. Cut into 3 cm squares. Place a pea-sized amount of the meat filling in the center of each square, then fold and seal the corners together. Once all are sealed, boil them in salted water until cooked, then drain. Serve topped with garlic yogurt and melted butter sizzled with red pepper flakes (if you want the meat filling to be more substantial, make the squares slightly larger and use hazelnut-sized portions).

title: Wild Mushroom and Gizzard Confit Quiche (Quiche aux Nébuleux et aux Gésiers Confits)

ingredients.raw: Salt, pepper, freshly ground black pepper, grated nutmeg
ingredients.item: salt, pepper, freshly ground black pepper, grated nutmeg

instructions:
In a pot of salted boiling water, blanch the mushrooms for 3-4 minutes. Rinse in cold water, drain, and press under a weight for 1-2 hours. Slice the gizzard confit and set aside. Finely chop the chives. Finely dice the shallots. In a pot, melt butter and sweat the onions. Add the mushrooms and stir well with a wooden spoon to evaporate their moisture. Stir in the chives. Adjust seasoning and chill.
In a bowl, whisk the cream, milk, and eggs. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Roll out the pastry and line a tart pan. Spread the mushroom and gizzard mixture in the center and pour the egg custard over it. Bake at 180°C (th. 6) for about 30 minutes until the quiche is golden brown.

title: Wild Shaggy Mane Mushroom Lasagna (Lasagnes aux Coulemelles à L'ail Doux)
instructions:
Sauté the shallots in olive oil in a pan for 2 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook over high heat for 7-8 minutes, stirring frequently. Season and set aside.
Peel and crush the garlic, and let it infuse in the cream over low heat. Melt 40g of butter in a saucepan and stir in the flour to make a roux (cook for 2 minutes). Whisk in the garlic-infused cream, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Cook, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Set aside.
Boil lasagna sheets in salted water until "al dente"; rinse with cold water and dry on a clean towel.
In a greased baking dish, layer pasta sheets, mushrooms, garlic béchamel, and sliced Cheddar. Repeat layers, ending with béchamel. Top with grated Parmesan and dot with butter. Bake under the broiler (or hot oven) for about 25 minutes.

title: Foie Gras au Torchon
instructions:
Take out the foie gras 1 hour before working. Separate the two lobes, and delicately remove the veins (vein map: 2 layers of "Y" veins on top, and a lower vein).
Season with 16g of seasoning per kilo of liver. Seasoning mix: Sichuan pepper, black pepper, and salt, crushed in a mortar. Distribute the seasoning on both sides.
Place in a salad bowl, add 3cl of cognac, and let marinate in the fridge for 30 min - 1 hour.
Lay out a torchon (towel), place the liver on it, roll the liver inside the torchon tightly, and secure the ends of the torchon with butcher's twine.
Boil water, add coarse salt, and submerge the torchon in the boiling water. Let return to a boil and immediately turn off the heat (water must completely cover the torchon).
Leave the torchon in the hot water to finish cooking, then let cool to room temperature (a few hours).
Remove the foie gras from the water, tighten the torchon to squeeze out excess fat, tie it back up, and leave in the fridge for 12 hours.

title: Pasta with Liver Sauté (Ci̇ğerli̇ Makarna)
instructions:
Bring a pot of water to a boil, adding salt. Add the pasta. Pour in 1 cup of cold water and 1 tablespoon of olive oil (adding olive oil prevents mushiness and sticking when swollen). Cook for 15-20 minutes. Remove from heat, pour in 1 cup of cold water, and drain after 5 minutes. Return the pasta to the pot, drizzle with a tablespoon of oil, and shake the pot gently to mix (do not stir with a spoon; mix by tossing/shaking).
Chop tomatoes coarsely. Boil until soft, then pass through a sieve to make a sauce.
Cut the liver into thin pencil-sized strips about 2 cm long. Sauté in oil in a pan, then pour the tomato sauce on top. Near the end of cooking, season with a tiny pinch of salt (remembering the pasta is already salted) and black pepper.
Plate the pasta, sprinkle with grated kashar cheese, and top with the hot liver sauté.

title: Cream of Lettuce (Crème de Laitue) (crème de Laitue à L'ail et au Bouquet Garni)
instructions: Follow the basic watercress soup recipe, substituting the watercress with a well-cleaned head of lettuce.

title: Cream of Mushroom (Crème de Champignons)
instructions: Follow the basic watercress soup recipe using washed, sliced button mushrooms.

title: Cream of Tomato (Crème de Tomates) (crème de Tomates à L'ail et au Bouquet Garni)
instructions: Follow the basic watercress soup recipe using peeled, chopped fresh tomatoes.

title: Garlic Soup From Arleux (Soupe à L'ail Arleusienne)
instructions:
Peel the potatoes and cut into quarters.
Peel the garlic cloves, making sure to remove the bitter green sprout from the center. Bring salted water to a boil.
Add the vegetables and simmer gently over low heat for 2 hours.
Once cooked, pass the soup through a food mill. Add cream (or butter) and serve hot.

title: Gratinated Onion Soup (Soupe à L'oignon Gratinée)
instructions:
Slice onions into rings and gently sauté in butter/margarine until golden brown. Sprinkle with flour, stirring continuously with a wooden spoon to create a golden-brown roux. Remove from heat and pour in all of the cold water at once. Whisk well to dissolve the flour, return to heat, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Add salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes in a standard pot (or 10 minutes in a pressure cooker).
Meanwhile, brown the bread slices in a pan or toast them in the oven.
Place the toasted bread slices in an oven-safe soup tureen. Pour the boiling hot onion soup over the bread. Generously sprinkle with grated gruyere cheese and bake in a hot oven for about 10 minutes or place under the broiler until bubbled and golden. Serve immediately.

title: Radish Top Cream Soup (Crème aux Fanes de Radis) (crème aux Fanes de Radis à L'ail et au Bouquet Garni)
instructions: Follow the basic watercress soup recipe (potage au cresson), substituting the watercress with thoroughly washed fresh radish tops.

title: Spring Vegetable Juice Soup (Potage de Printemps)
instructions:
Wash the tomatoes and cut into quarters. Wash the bell pepper, de-seed, remove ribs, and chop into cubes. Wash and slice the celery. Wash and scrape the carrots. Peel and slice the cucumber.
Peel and quarter the onion and garlic.
Run all ingredients through a juicer, starting with tomatoes, then celery, carrots, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, garlic, and lemon.
Pour the juice into a soup tureen and season with salt and pepper.
Chill in the refrigerator for 2 hours and serve with a bowl of toasted croutons.

title: Şehriye Soup (Şehriye Çorbası)
instructions: Sauté bell pepper paste (3 spoon), add oil then add water (3 lt) and peeled onion (1 whole). When water starts boiling, add 125 gr şehriye, mint, salt. Cook until şehriye cooks.
